report: Task 8 two-circle end-to-end acceptance, software/vcan layer

scope.qualified_here: Linux processes, loopback UDP, deployed systemd services, actual C-core model, management HTTP, gateway semantic gates
scope.not_qualified_here: physical CAN FD, physical network interfaces, IRIG/clock hardware, hard real-time qualification
scope.statement: All results below are Linux software/vcan acceptance evidence and must not be reported as physical CAN FD or RT qualification.

scheduling_change.rationale: Wire captures showed ID10 staging only 27-35 model steps before the frozen step-250 boundary at the old settings. The gateway needs the stage request before C reaches 250; the executor's first heartbeat after START is the controlling latency. Polling at the contract heartbeat period and triggering at a larger lead moves the stage to model steps 98-137 on an idle/fresh store.

clean_fresh_store_batch.summary: 5/5 passes, one ID10 TX each, scenario APPLIED at model step 250, STOP with HIL_STOP_APPLIED and status-stopped-safe, final state COMPLETED/INCOMPLETE

coverage_in_positive_harness.telemetry_state_frame: STATE_TELEMETRY with lifecycle RUNNING and sequence matching the model step
coverage_in_positive_harness.stop_safety: STOPPED, control_source NONE, motor_command [0,0,0,0], sequence == model_step, exactly one HIL_START_APPLIED and one HIL_STOP_APPLIED

message3_drift_direct_formal.setup: SourceSession opened through the deployed gateway; message ID 3 sent with random_seed changed 1 -> 2 while HIL was CONFIGURED
message3_drift_direct_formal.conclusion: Rejected at the gateway semantic gate before any C configure write

unprepared_first_circle.setup: hil-prepare stopped; hil-core@current restarted without preparation; core was STOPPED, sequence 0, model_revision 0
unprepared_first_circle.required_result: no TX when the first circle was never prepared
unprepared_first_circle.actual_result: the second circle configured the model itself and transmitted ID10
unprepared_first_circle.note: This is Finding B, deliberately not fixed in this acceptance run; it must remain an open acceptance gap.

residual_margin_failure_under_load.context: Full 1275-test ICD regression suite running concurrently; run store held about 300 remembered requests (~1.1 MB)
residual_margin_failure_under_load.conclusion: The first scenario heartbeat observed a model step beyond the frozen 250 boundary, so no ID10 TX was possible. The delay is the executor persisting HIL_START_APPLIED evidence through the run store, which rewrites and fsyncs the whole store. Scenario lead tuning cannot recover a 261 ms post-START stall.

growing_store_batch.summary: Margins shrink as the store grows; case 5 then missed the boundary under suite load

request_registry_capacity.observation: run store reached 512/512 remembered requests; remember() raised CAPACITY and management HTTP returned 400 invalid_request for CREATE/GET/RECORDS
request_registry_capacity.cause: max_requests=512 with no eviction of terminal runs or read-only command ids
request_registry_capacity.workaround_used: stop input-simulator, move the store to the archive directory, restart; test evidence preserved

full_store_persistence_in_hot_path.observation: every management command rewrites and fsyncs the entire store under an RLock; the executor's RUNNING evidence write sits between START APPLIED and the first scenario heartbeat
full_store_persistence_in_hot_path.measured: fresh/idle store: START reply to first heartbeat 97-145 ms and scenario margins 113-152 steps; grown/loaded store: 196-304 ms and margins 32-54 steps, with one boundary miss
full_store_persistence_in_hot_path.recommendation: use an append-only journal or bounded/compacted persistence and keep the post-START evidence write out of the ID10 staging critical path

full_suite.failure: test_scenario_driver.ScenarioDriverTests.test_service_poll_session_change_cannot_cache_completion raised TARGET_MISSING under the loaded 32-minute run
full_suite.classification: load-induced timing flake, unrelated to the simulator runtime-config change
